_doc: stage3d: walking a floor in 3D (docs/gameplay/24_STAGE_3D.md). The floor's walls and ground are a model made from its tile map by tools/stage3d/make_floor3d.py (model: {id} = the floor's id); a floor without one is drawn in 2D.
on: false = every floor in 2D. Also off with --walk-3d=off, and in scripted runs unless --walk-3d=on.

camera: pitch (degrees down from level), distance (metres from the hero), fov (degrees, up and down), follow (how fast it catches up with the hero: 1/s), lookAhead (metres north of the hero it looks at).

sprites: the map's sprites standing in the scene: glow (their own light), lean (degrees they lean back toward the camera; 0 = upright), heights (metres for a one-tile sprite, by kind: player, monster, npc, item, door, event, other), shadow (the soft disc under each: its radius in metres; 0 = none), paintedHero (the hero drawn as his weapon's painted battle character, its idle clip, turned the way he last walked) and paintedHeroHeight (metres).

looks: by the floor's theme (its stage file's "theme"), "default" for the rest: sky (an HDR or JPG: hdr, intensity, yaw, blur; background false = it only lights, the tower stands in the dark), exposure, light (dir, color, intensity, ambient) as battle.json stages3d.
